author: Garrett Howlett
text: I had a great experience with Bailey's Sewer & Drain, LLC. They responded promptly, arrived on time, and quickly identified the problem. The technician explained everything clearly, completed the repair efficiently, and made sure everything was working properly before leaving. The pricing was fair, and the service was professional from start to finish. I'd definitely call them again for any future plumbing or drain issues.

author: Bre Rinkema
text: Josh is fantastic! He was quick to help with our issue, has wonderful time management and great communication. Not to mention is very affordable compared to others in town. Highly recommend!

author: Christina Goodall
text: BUYER BEWARE! I caught Josh Bailey, one of the owners of this company, stealing from me and have him on video doing it. I hired Bailey's based off a personal recommendation and their good reviews online. He seemed nice, but I was extremely disappointed (to say the least) when I caught him going through my closed cabinets, attempting to break into locked ones, and stealing my personal items. He stuffed items down his pants and carried them out to his truck.  Once caught and confronted he admitted to stealing, but he was trying to get away with it up until then. I am only posting this as a warning to others --  I do not recommend hiring this company, especially if he is in your home or near anything of value.

author: Shannan Glatz
text:
Kitchen sink clog became a rotten pipe issue. As soon as Josh removed the connectors he saw the clog and rotten pipe. He was able to stop all the leaks without replacing the pipe. He stayed until he verified the clog was gone and there were no leaks. I recommend this company as they are very thorough and polite. Thank you so much for your help today!

April 2, 2026 Josh came out to run a camera through my sewer line and had me watch. I have never seen the inside of my sewer line or any others for that matter. Anyway mine was in need of being replaced, but that was not all he found! When he got to the street the camera just stopped. So this became a issue from work done on the main sewer line so thanks to Josh this was caught before it all backed up into my sewer line and house. Thank you so much Bailey's Sewer & Drain, LLC

author: Claire DeWeber
text: Josh was so knowledgeable and helpful with a sewage issue I was having. Great service and fair pricing. I highly recommend if you need anything done!
